title: SUN direct-writer identity remapping and record rollback

operation.scope: Direct dxfRW::writeSun record API; ASCII and Binary DXF
operation.source: Generated DRW_Sun records authored in the C++ test; no physical DWG/DXF source fixture
operation.fixturePolicy: No persistent DWG/DXF fixtures added. Test records and outputs are in-memory.
changes: Allocate a nonzero output handle when a direct SUN record has no source handle.
Apply caller handle remapping and reserve the emitted identity for explicit source handles; bind source object identity only after record serialization succeeds.
Remap the SUN owner, check each serialized field write, and commit bytes and record-local state together.
Preserve the documented group-63 color projection and existing refusal of unsupported CMC RGB/name/book metadata.

asciiBinary.result: PASS (1/1). The selector exercises ASCII and Binary: default handle allocation and root owner C; explicit 0xA500/0xA501 to 0xB500/0xB501 identity/owner remapping; documented color group 63; and continued refusal of unrepresentable CMC color/name state.

rollbackAndRetry.result: PASS in ASCII and Binary. An invalid XDATA variant is rejected after the SUN body has been staged; the pre-existing destination prefix remains byte-for-byte unchanged. A corrected record succeeds with a fresh writer. The writer's failure flag is sticky, so this direct-record selector does not claim same-instance retry.

build.result: PASS with the configured warning-as-error build.

limits: This qualifies the direct codec writer's identity and transaction behavior only; dx_iface does not yet route DWG-origin typed SUN records through it.
The existing physical sun-and-sky DWG does not qualify the scalar-only color route because its SUN objects contain CMC RGB metadata that the documented SUN DXF group set cannot represent faithfully.
No physical DWG owner graph, VPORT/VIEWPORT consumer closure, native rendering, independent CAD acceptance, full suite, or support claim is qualified.
nextAction: Implement the DWG-origin typed-only SUN output route for group-63-faithful profiles, close/remap VPORT and VIEWPORT owner/reference edges, preserve DXF-origin raw replay, and keep unsupported CMC states refused. Then inspect staged output and fresh readback before any native consumer qualification.
